summary: TN State Parks Campground South confirmed: 54 paved water + 20/30/50A RV sites (no sewer, to 91 ft, 3 pull-throughs) + 10 tent + 9 primitive; $40-62 (stored $40-48; holiday weekends $62); year-round; showers, dump, camp store, wifi. Pin moved ~720 m to the RV loops. Phone: lodge 931-364-2222 kept or -> park office 931-364-7724. Not waterfront kept.
